name: Akhtar Ahmed
role: Senior Secretary of Bangladesh's Election Commission Secretariat
contribution: Akhtar Ahmed served as the senior secretary of Bangladesh's Election Commission Secretariat during the 2026 national election cycle. His work involved the administrative machinery supporting voter-list updates, political-party registration, election logistics, public briefings, and the commission's formal record.
context: A 1982 Bangladesh Civil Service Administration cadre officer, Ahmed later worked in public administration and retired in 2015. He joined the Election Commission Secretariat as senior secretary on 5 December 2024 on a two-year contractual appointment. The role placed him at the centre of election administration during preparations for the 13th Jatiya Sangsad election and the concurrent referendum in 2026; it did not make him a member of the Election Commission itself.
impact: Ahmed became a prominent administrative spokesperson for the Election Commission during a period of institutional transition. He reported on voter registration, election preparation, observer engagement, turnout, and results-related processes, helping communicate the commission's work to political parties, journalists, and the public. His profile should remain date-specific because the senior secretary position and election timetable are time-sensitive.
highlight: Akhtar Ahmed was the senior administrative official coordinating public-facing Election Commission Secretariat work during Bangladesh's 2026 election cycle.
